canonical_statement: TOKEN_VAZIO is an explicit epistemic state and is not equivalent to zero, false, irrelevance, PASS or verified evidence.
falsifiers: A TOKEN_VAZIO record is promoted to VERIFIED, CLOSED or claim_allowed=true without the missing observation being supplied.
urgency_reason: Every downstream gate depends on preserving uncertainty without converting absence into evidence.
token_vazio_reason: The new registry has not yet emitted a CI receipt and cross-repository bindings are not closed.
next_verifiable_step: Run the invariant audit in CI and bind its receipt to the branch commit SHA.

canonical_statement: Evidence promotion requires traceable source identity, object integrity and append-only custody; corrections supersede explicitly instead of silently rewriting history.
falsifiers: A custody event accepts a missing object, broken hash, non-monotonic predecessor or silent correction while still allowing promotion.
urgency_reason: Broken provenance invalidates receipts, federation and any later claim even when code executes successfully.
token_vazio_reason: Domain test and CI bindings have not yet been reconciled into this registry; cross-repository custody remains open.
next_verifiable_step: Link existing custody tests and receipts by invariant_id, then run the registry audit.

canonical_statement: The canonical Mapa dependency structure must remain reference-complete, acyclic, non-orphaned and epistemically consistent with active=FATO and planned=LACUNA.

authority.evidence: derived topology report and repository checkout

falsifiers: A required node is orphaned, cyclic, self-dependent, references a missing dependency, has a mismatched epistemic mark or a divergent integrity digest.
urgency_reason: Topology is the routing substrate for dependencies, gaps and critical paths; corruption propagates across all later procedures.
token_vazio_reason: The implementation exists but domain test, CI and federated topology bindings are not yet canonicalized here.
next_verifiable_step: Bind topology tests and the latest topology receipt to this invariant_id.

canonical_statement: Declaration, implementation, execution, evidence and claim are distinct states; a workflow may promote only through explicit evidence gates and human review where execution or publication requires it.

authority.evidence: workflow reports, artifacts, measurements and review

falsifiers: A planned or blocked stage is treated as executed, or claim_allowed=true is accepted without the required evidence and closed dependencies.
urgency_reason: False execution promotion creates the highest-risk form of regression because documentation can masquerade as operational proof.
token_vazio_reason: Domain test and CI bindings are not reconciled and physical runtime is source-specific.
next_verifiable_step: Attach execution-gate tests and one same-cut receipt that preserves source, artifact, runtime and claim boundaries.

canonical_statement: Necessity, urgency, importance and priority are distinct, and structural similarity or common grouping never implies SAME_SITUATION without matching context, invariant states and explicit evidence.

authority.evidence: operational triage registry and relation evidence

falsifiers: Two records with mismatched domain, target, privacy, epistemic state or invariant state are accepted as SAME_SITUATION, or priority diverges from its score vector.
urgency_reason: Context collapse can merge distinct risks and route the wrong corrective action even when individual validators are correct.
token_vazio_reason: Domain test, CI and cross-repository relation bindings are still unregistered in the canonical invariant graph.
next_verifiable_step: Bind triage tests and register evidence-backed SAME_SITUATION and STRUCTURAL_ANALOG examples.

canonical_statement: Longitudinal evolution must preserve ancestors, type every new dimension and sourced relation, require a supersession receipt for removals and never silently overwrite prior state.

authority.evidence: versioned vectors, hashes, typed gaps and supersession receipts

falsifiers: A revision removes or changes an ancestor without a supersession receipt, introduces an untyped dimension, an unsourced relation or a calibrated weight without evidence.
urgency_reason: Silent overwrite is direct regression; longitudinal integrity is required before continuous feedback can be trusted.
token_vazio_reason: Tests, CI and federated ancestor chains are not yet fully mapped into this registry.
next_verifiable_step: Bind longitudinal tests and a supersession fixture to the invariant registry.

canonical_statement: Federated memory must preserve producer identity, immutable refs, authority boundaries and contradictions; projection into Mapa cannot increase certainty or erase contradiction.

authority.evidence: producer repositories and pinned pointer registry

falsifiers: Pinned memory pointers disagree on producer ref/path/blob, an authority boundary is missing, or a producer CONTRADICTION is projected as a non-contradiction.
urgency_reason: Federation is where locally correct truths can become globally incoherent if identity and contradiction are not preserved.
token_vazio_reason: Cross-repository receipts and complete producer reconciliation remain open.
next_verifiable_step: Attach producer-specific receipts and verify all pinned refs against current repository heads without auto-promotion.

canonical_statement: Git history topology is not semantic novelty: ahead commits do not prove new meaning, merged PR does not prove canonical main presence, and supersession must preserve the source pointer.

authority.evidence: branch observations, blob equivalence and canonicalization receipts

falsifiers: A branch is auto-promoted solely because it is ahead, or a noncanonical merged PR is treated as present on main without checking canonical paths and blobs.
urgency_reason: Branch drift can reintroduce superseded artifacts or hide unmerged semantics while appearing newer by commit count.
token_vazio_reason: Repository-wide branch reconciliation is intentionally not declared closed.
next_verifiable_step: Bind branch-evolution tests and refresh the observation manifest against the current main head.

canonical_statement: Workflow success does not prove dependency compatibility: external actions require immutable pinning, least privilege and independent license/runtime provenance before compatibility claims.

authority.evidence: workflow dependency audit and pinned action references

falsifiers: An unpinned external action, write-capable token, persisted checkout credential or unaudited runtime/license dependency is treated as compatible and promotable.
urgency_reason: Supply-chain drift can invalidate otherwise correct receipts and silently change execution semantics.
token_vazio_reason: The dependency contract has tests but the new invariant-registry CI binding and complete dependency provenance are still open.

canonical_statement: Numerical convergence, visual similarity, semantic pattern or same-implementation CI reproduction do not constitute physical confirmation or independent scientific replication.

falsifiers: A numerical or semantic match is promoted to a physical law without preregistration, controls, operator sensitivity, remeshing and independent implementation replication.
urgency_reason: Scientific boundaries must remain explicit so operational receipts cannot be mistaken for evidence of a physical mechanism.
token_vazio_reason: The hypothesis has same-implementation reproduction recorded in its source contract, but validator/test/workflow path bindings and independent implementation replication remain unregistered here.
next_verifiable_step: Bind the exact spectral validator, tests, workflow and independent-replication evidence before changing any scientific promotion state.

canonical_statement: First internal mention, first definition, first formula, first artifact, first commit, first execution, first public disclosure, legal priority and scientific novelty are distinct evidence states and must never be inferred from one another without explicit source linkage.

A later alias is retrodated to an earlier precursor without explicit source evidence, or a missing chronology field is filled by inference instead of TOKEN_VAZIO.
urgency_reason: Chronology conflation can retrodate authorship or overstate disclosure, legal priority and scientific novelty even when source hashes are correct.
